name: WPNakama – Team and multi-Client Collaboration, Editorial and Project Management
author: qdonow

sections.description:
WPNakama is built by a studio for studios and agencies. We know the pain of handling an agency. We need to take care of clients, work allocation, hierarchy, deadlines, files, transparency, team productivity, clarity, marketing, etc.

All of this is not just limited to digital agencies but all kinds of service businesses as law firms, accounting firms, distributors, etc. We all share the same pain points.

Unfortunately, we need to depend on hundreds of tools and give up our autonomy and of course a chunk of revenue.

On average an agency spends $2500 USD yearly on digital tools for agency management.

WPNakama is our attempt to bring this bill down significantly and bring productivity and transparency at the core.

Features

WPNakama brings all your content, tasks, sprints, teammates, and strategies together in the WordPress dashboard. WPNakama helps WordPress design teams, developer teams, marketing teams, editorial teams, etc., manage and collaborate in your WordPress dashboard.

😍 Best Management Tool for the following:

  1. Service Businesses
  2. Law Firms
  3. Accounting Firms
  4. Distributors
  5. Publications
  6. Agencies
  7. Firms
  8. Editorial Team
  9. WordPress Design Teams
  10. WordPress Developer Team
  11. Content Marketing Teams
  12. Bloggers
  13. Writers

🗝️ Key Features of WPNakama (FREE)

  • Editorial Planner: Planning editorials made easy with Kanban boards and direct access of tasks in WordPress posts editor.
  • Kanban Board like Trello: Kanban board in WordPress. Collaborate with your team and clients seamlessly.
  • Public Client Portal: A client portal to access tasks, files and projects. More features coming soon.
  • Deadlines: Add a deadline to your boards.
  • Add Sub-tasks: Break your tasks into smaller, manageable to-dos.
  • Manage Sub-tasks from Post Editor: Manage your to-do list directly from the post editor.
  • Add Due Dates to Tasks: Set due dates for individual tasks to keep your projects on track.
  • Pre-made Kanban Board Templates: Get started quickly with pre-made board templates.
  • Pin Important Boards to Top: Pin your important boards to the top of the list for quick access.
  • Notes in Tasks: Add detailed notes to each task to provide context and information.

PRO Features:

  • Unlimited Boards & Tasks: Create as many boards and tasks as you need without any restrictions.
  • Store & Share Files like Dropbox: Store digital assets securely in WordPress. Share with team and clients with ease.
  • Customize Board URL: Didn’t like default URL of your board? Set a custom slug for your boards to make them more rememberable and SEO friendly.
  • Clone Boards: No need to create a board from scratch. Clone boards to create a new board with the same tasks and todos.
  • Protect Client Portal with Password: Confidently share your board, tasks, projects and files with only those who have the password.
  • Assign Team Members to Tasks: Assign tasks to your team members and keep track of their progress.
  • Changelog: See progress and changes happening throughout the board.
  • Priority Support: Get priority support from our team for any issues or questions.
  • Regular Updates: Enjoy regular updates with new features and improvements.
  • More Features Coming Soon: We are constantly working on new features to enhance your experience.
sections.installation:
1. Upload wpnakama to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Can i use it before buying?

Of course! You can use of free and open-source plugin on wordpress.org plugin directly.

How to unpin a board?

Same process but now you need to click on unpin from the menu.

Can I arrange pinned boards as per my preference?

At the moment, this feature is not available.

Can I change the board style later?

Of course, you can update your board style as per your requirements.

Can I save my board structure as a template?

At the moment there is no option to save the board as a template but you can create a board and then duplicate it as many times as you need. It works exactly like using a template.

Is there any other board view available than Kanban?

At the moment only Kanban view is available.

Can I add time to the deadline?

No, you can not. You can give a start and end date only.

Is there any way to see the deadline without going in the board?

All the deadlines are also visible on board cards on the board page.

Can I change the sharable link?

Yes, you can change the shareable link through the Change Slug option. In fact, it is highly recommended to change the default board link to a more readable and memorable link before sharing it with clients.

Can publicly shareable boards get listed on search engines like Google?

No, boards don’t get listed on search engines like Google.
